name: Grid-based Scene Cropping with KNN Precomputation
definition: Generates cropped point cloud datasets by dividing a normalized scene into a 3D grid, applying padding, and precomputing K-nearest neighbors (KNN) for both input points and grid voxels to facilitate local feature grouping.
summary: Grid-based Scene Cropping with KNN Precomputation generates cropped point cloud datasets by precomputing KNN indices and relative coordinates for both points and voxels to facilitate local feature grouping.
